/**
 * `dsh-s2s` browser half — the session-history panel.
 *
 * A sidebar surface answering "which conversations exist, grouped by
 * workspace, and where did each one stop" WITHOUT rendering message content:
 * every row quotes a conversation (title, short id, state, when it was last
 * touched), so the user can see where a thread broke off and click back into
 * it. Content is reachable the normal way — this panel is an index, not a
 * reader.
 *
 * Everything rendered comes from state the browser already holds — the
 * `sessions` service (`ctx.sessions.list`) and the `workspaces` service — so
 * the panel adds no host round-trip, no new service and no new RPC.
 *
 * This file is the loader's closure-factory artifact by hand, so the package
 * needs no client build step: it registers a factory on the page's module
 * queue and resolves React through the module table the shell seeds. Written
 * in the same shape as the other out-of-tree client halves in this profile.
 */
intro:
var module = { exports: {} }
    var exports = module.exports
